content: Add `PostgresMediaStore` over a caller-owned asyncpg-compatible pool
Add a live Postgres suite for `PostgresStepStore` and `PostgresMediaStore`
Run the Postgres store suite in CI against a `postgres:17` service
Cover foreign table layouts and damaged snapshot rows in the live Postgres suite

Narrow the metadata column type in PostgresMediaStore.get_metadata

A NULL or non-text metadata cell from a hand-written row surfaced as a bare
JSONDecodeError; narrowing like the sibling get() keeps foreign-layout reads
failing with the same clear error. Also drop a Unicode arrow from the class
docstring per the harness writing style.

Drop the CI workflow change for a maintainer to carry forward

The .github Directory Guard only accepts .github/ changes from maintainers.
The harness-postgres-integration job this branch added is preserved in commit
65753ce20 for a maintainer to cherry-pick into a separate PR, per the guard's
instructions; issue #8991's testing decision depends on it.

Restrict Postgres table prefixes to lowercase identifiers

PostgreSQL folds unquoted identifiers to lowercase, so 'Orders' and 'orders'
silently shared the same tables across supposedly distinct stores (found by
review on the PR). Rejecting uppercase at construction makes the aliasing
impossible instead of documented. Also fix the 'pip/uv-add asyncpg' typo in
the media docs.

Re-export the pool protocols from their public home in media

Pyright rejects re-importing PostgresConnection/PostgresPool through
step_persistence._postgres (reportPrivateImportUsage), which failed the CI
quality checks; importing from pydantic_ai_harness.media matches where they
are defined and publicly exported.

Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/main' into feat/postgres-step-store

One conflict, in the imports of `tests/harness/media/test_media.py`:
main moved to `datetime.UTC` while this branch added
`AbstractAsyncContextManager`; both are kept.

Main's lint now flags `timezone.utc` (UP017), so the live Postgres suite
uses `UTC` as well.

Add `PostgresStepStore` and `PostgresMediaStore`, the hosted Postgres backends for messages and media - Fixes #8991 Supersedes #9453: the issue-link guard closed it before GitHub had resolved the issue reference, and it can no longer be reopened because its head branch was deleted. Same commits, plus a merge of `main`. `StepPersistence` has in-memory, file, SQLite and Mongo backends, while `Memory` already pairs its SQLite default with a hosted Postgres option. This adds the missing half of that pairing for messages, as specified in #8991: `PostgresStepStore`, plus `PostgresMediaStore` for the `media_store='auto'` default every other step store has. The implementation copies the load-bearing patterns from `PostgresMemoryStore` (caller-owned asyncpg-compatible pool behind a local `Protocol`, `_TABLE_RE`-validated `table=` prefix, `_ensure_schema` behind an `anyio.Lock`, `connection.transaction()`) and preserves `SqliteStepStore`'s semantic contracts, with the issue-preferred `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` idempotency in place of SQLite's trigger approach. ### New public surface - `pydantic_ai_harness.step_persistence.PostgresStepStore` - `pydantic_ai_harness.media.PostgresMediaStore` - `pydantic_ai_harness.media.PostgresPool` / `PostgresConnection` — driver-neutral protocols, re-exported from `step_persistence`; the harness takes on no driver dependency. ### User-visible behavior ```python pool = await asyncpg.create_pool('postgresql://...') # caller-owned persistence = StepPersistence(store=PostgresStepStore(pool), agent_name='support') ``` Events and snapshots are ordered by a `BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY` sequence that keeps counting when `ctx.run_step` resets; large blobs externalize to `{table}_media` on the same pool by default. ### Verification - `src/pydantic_ai_harness/integration_tests/postgres/test_live_postgres.py` — behavior suite against a real server. The matching `harness-postgres-integration` CI job (`postgres:17` service; not path-gated, runs under `coverage run`, merges into the `coverage` job and the final gate, not in `allowed-skips` for code PRs, per the issue's testing decision) lives in commit 65753ce20 but is **not in this diff**: the `.github` Directory Guard only accepts workflow changes from maintainers, so it needs to be carried forward in a separate PR (see the guard's comment on #9453). Until then, nothing on this PR runs the live suite in CI, so **the `coverage` gate fails here**: the two new modules are only executed end to end by the live suite (38% and 27% from the no-server tests). - `tests/harness/step_persistence/test_postgres.py`, `tests/harness/media/test_postgres.py` — construction and validation on the ordinary matrix legs, no server required. - Locally: full suite green against `postgres:17` via `make integration-postgres`. One heads-up for reviewers, pre-existing on `main` and left to a maintainer decision rather than changed here: `PostgresMemoryStore`'s `_TABLE_RE` has the same uppercase-folding exposure this PR closes for the new stores (`'Orders'` aliases `'orders'` on unquoted identifiers), but it has released users, so tightening it is a compatibility decision. ### What changes for existing users Nothing — purely additive. ### Checklist - [x] No **breaking changes** in accordance with the [version policy](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/blob/main/docs/version-policy.md). - [x] Any permitted **compatibility impact** has a label, warning, migration, release note, and exact API-check waiver. (None.) - [x] **PR title** is fit for the [release changelog](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Thanks for the contribution! To make sure changes are discussed before code is written, we ask that every PR references an existing issue with a closing keyword (e.g. `Fixes #1234`) in its description, so this PR has been closed automatically.

If there's no issue for this yet, please open one first (e.g. a bug report with a reproducible example), wait for a maintainer to confirm it, then update this PR's description to reference it and reopen the PR.

Documentation-only fixes are exempt and don't need an issue.

Use the `pip/uv-add` shorthand for the asyncpg install in the media docs

The harness docs convention, enforced by `tests/harness/test_docs_installation.py`,
is one `pip/uv-add` line in its own bash fence rather than a hand-written
`pip install` or `uv add` command.

Cover the Postgres stores in the unit suites against an in-memory SQLite pool

The live Postgres suite does not run in CI, so the coverage job saw only the
construction tests. SqlitePool satisfies PostgresPool over in-memory SQLite,
rewriting the few Postgres-only spellings, so reads, writes, idempotency,
retention, and media externalization run in every test job.
